description: Active published configurable product on the store with at least N active in-stock variants (each picked by its attribute values), plus the add-on groups and personalizable attributes the test fills in. KB: Product Types (Configurable); Configuring Product Add-ons.

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test sets for this product in the cart

minAddOns.description: Add-on groups the test selects on this product (0 when it selects none)

minPersonalizableAttributes.description: Personalizable text attributes the test fills in (0 when none)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

minVariants.description: Distinct variants the test adds to the cart

addOnDisplayType.description: Stored ZnodePimAddonGroup.DisplayType of the add-on group the test selects (CheckBox, RadioButton or DropDown). Pass only when minAddOns >= 1

personalizationAttribute.description: Personalizable attribute code the test types into (ZnodePimAttribute.AttributeCode, e.g. AdditionalInformation, DisplayText). Pass only when minPersonalizableAttributes >= 1

variantAttributes.description: Comma-separated list (no list type in the schema) of the configurable attribute codes (ZnodePimAttribute.AttributeCode) the test picks the variant by; the product must vary by all of them
